expo.reason: Use the coordinated Expo 58.0.5 / React Native 0.88.0-rc.3 dependency set under runtime 1.8.16. Preserve source guards, lifecycle regression coverage and native build validation before release.

@sentry/react-native.reason: Sentry 8.30 updates Android SDK 8.59.0 to 8.60.0, Cocoa SDK 9.30.0 to 9.30.1 and JavaScript SDK 10.75.2 to 10.76.0. Its Expo Gradle integration resolves the SDK from the Android project, and runtime 1.8.19 regenerates native projects while preserving crash mirroring, consent and symbol uploads.

react-native-gesture-handler.reason: Retain Gesture Handler 3.3 and the existing gesture API with the coordinated Expo 58 native runtime.

react-native-safe-area-context.reason: Safe-area 5.10.1 preserves the 5.10.0 Android/iOS implementation and fixes SwiftPM package metadata; validate its integration in runtime 1.8.14.

react-native-web.reason: Retain Expo 58.0.5's bundled ~0.21.3 with the guarded shared asset registry and passing Hosting/Pages exports. React Native Web 0.21.4 adds public AssetRegistry entry points and removes deprecation warnings; adopt it with the coordinated Expo CLI asset-registry update.

@babel/core.reason: Babel 8.0.7 compiles mocked TypeScript and JSX test fixtures. Expo and Worklets retain the separately pinned Babel 7 adapter because their transforms still require Babel 7 APIs.

typescript.reason: TypeScript 7 checks the app and crash-reporting workspace. ESLint uses the official TypeScript 6 compatibility package for its compiler API.

react-native-reanimated.reason: Reanimated 4.7.1 supports React Native 0.88 and Worklets 0.13 and adds native teardown and layout-animation crash fixes. Runtime 1.8.15 regenerates native projects, rebases the callback-cleanup patch and verifies the upstream native-state guard with lifecycle tests and Android/iOS builds.
